In addition to releasing the public beta 2 of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple also simultaneously launched the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 today. Details are as follows.

Older versions of macOS continue to receive security updates

As usual, Apple has directly released the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 this time, without releasing any regular beta versions beforehand.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 at the end of last month, and both versions went through two release candidates before their official launch.

The release notes attached by Apple to the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only state that the updates "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users to install." Apple is expected to announce the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, along with macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, within the next few weeks after their official release.

The build number of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the build number of macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.

Have you discovered any new features or changes in this release candidate? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
